title: Medicare new card fee, ACH to new payee

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hello, this is the Medicare enrollment center. Medicare is issuing new plastic cards with chips and your old card will be deactivated at five pm today.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I did not get any letter about that.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: The letters went out late. To keep your coverage active we need the three hundred fifty dollar card activation fee by bank transfer today. Without it your prescriptions will be rejected at the pharmacy tomorrow.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I cannot miss my prescriptions. Where do I send it?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: To the Medicare Benefits Center account I will read to you now.

review_note: signals_required. ACH to a new payee, tiny amount, not on mule list. Only urgency plus new payee (H-04) or authority plus payment language (H-05) can hold it. Medicare never charges for cards. allowed_rule_ids widened to ['H-04', 'H-05', 'H-06'] on 2026-10-24 00:50 after both the mock and the real extractor fired those rules on language that is actually in the transcript (eval-engineer diagnosis); outcome unchanged.
